brief: Design a calm but information-dense operations console for experienced dispatchers. Show 30 active jobs without making them scroll through large cards. Avoid playful styling and decorative gradients.
A reading app for long essays: warm, editorial, quiet, like a well-set journal. Not a SaaS dashboard. Reading comfort comes first; offer a day/night switch.
A playful but professional booking form for a children's science museum. Parents need a quick, reassuring way to reserve a visit. Avoid cartoon overload or childish tiny type.
Create a project workspace for researchers. Make it zorbly. That word is our team's private design descriptor; no definition is provided yet.
A premium, airy, light-mode catalog for handmade ceramics. Avoid dark luxury styling, gold accents, and dense dashboard layouts. Help shoppers compare dimensions and add an item to their cart.

brief.user_goal: Build a polished single-page independent film production checklist interface. Provide a task called Prepare materials, a toggle control (task-toggle), and a text status (task-status), initially Pending. Activating the control changes it to Completed; activating again restores Pending. Parentheses specify required data-testid values.
audience: people using this service on desktop and mobile

brief.user_goal: Build a polished single-page local volunteer signup interface. Provide a labeled Name input (name), Email input (email), submit control (submit), and status (form-status). An empty submission must visibly say Required. After filling a name and valid email, submission must say Confirmed. Implement local validation with noValidate so an empty submission reaches the handler. Label it a demo, not a real booking. Parentheses specify required data-testid values.
audience: people using this service on desktop and mobile
